name: Lina Farrell
life: “I still remember our family's worst quarrel told as a cheerful story elsewhere.” On Tuesday, near Maré Coffee, Lina likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I am the second wife's cousin. I can tell these people about a good father they never got.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a boxy denim jacket and a folded shopping list secured by a miniature clip. Lina has a long face and high cheekbones, with a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears. Lina looks down for a moment before saying something difficult during a conversation.
personality: Lina tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Lina will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To let the two branches of the family tell different truths.
family: Karina Hamilton is Lina’s half-sibling. Lina sets the time to leave. Karina picks the meeting place. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *The waiting-room plant*, Karina says, “I took the original cutting on the day my husband came home.”
connections: Damian Mack. The second branch of the family has a different name for the man everybody is trying to greet.

reactions.situation: The returning father wants a family photograph immediately
reactions.response: Lina asks each household member privately whether they want to be in the picture.

reactions.situation: A stranger waves a phone camera in a crying person's face
reactions.response: Lina offers an ordinary errand that lets the distressed person leave without being followed by an audience.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Lina repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
